findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "prisma_flow_diagram" stacks urgency/override words (always, never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_evidence · Private data: format_citations, check_retractions, prisma_flow_diagram, screening_log, find_tools · Public sink: find_datasets · Destructive: format_citations, find_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_evidence · Private data: format_citations, check_retractions, prisma_flow_diagram, screening_log, find_tools · Public sink: find_datasets · Destructive: format_citations, find_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify_references" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
